title: subscribe_events double-copies valid UTF-8 chunk data
description: client.rs subscribe_events (lines 413-418): on the happy path (valid UTF-8, no split codepoint) the code does s.to_owned() to clone raw_buf contents into a new String, then push_str appends that into buf — two copies of the same bytes. Fix: use String::from_utf8 with drain to move bytes instead of cloning, or decode directly into buf.
